name: marauding_raptor_dinosaur_enters_raptor_gets_plus_2
notes: Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control enters, this creature deals 2 damage to it. If a Dinosaur is dealt damage this way, this creature gets +2/+0 until end of turn.' A 3/4 Dinosaur enters under P0: it has 2 damage, and the Raptor is 4/3.
